limitations: Single profiled run per backend/stage, no repeated unprofiled timing comparison.
Console caller times are weighted CPU samples under DebugConsole.log, not exact invocation counts.
Absence of sampled console stacks alone cannot prove a call never ran; developer gate behavior is checked in source/existing tests.
Inclusive times overlap. Warmup screenshots are limited checkpoints, not every-weapon visual acceptance.
Pre-existing other-agent ModelLoader/ProjectileManager/FPS DevLog changes are present in the captured source.
